findings.desc: Concept review passed: gap-analyze now models DONE and DISCARDED as terminal phases via an explicit terminalPhases set, while the smoke test proves DEV remains a non-terminal blocker. Diff scope is limited to convergence false blockers, summary annotation metadata, and the dedicated regression script; no high-gap backfill was included.

Quality review: no blocking maintainability issue found in gap-analyze terminal phase filtering, summary metadata backfill, convergence-discarded smoke, or package script wiring. The new smoke covers both terminal-only and active-story cases, and the production change keeps terminal phases centralized via a typed Set.

Blocking channel issue: koala validate --channel --story=B-952f fails because commit a322332 has author Harmonygo and subject "fix: exclude discarded stories from convergence". Channel gate expects author=koala-implementer or a subject prefixed with "koala:" before REVIEW can advance to TEST.
Coverage review passed: build, convergence discarded smoke, e2e, and koala validate --story all passed; Koala reports verification intent coverage 9/9 with 0 required missing.

Docs review passed: this story changes convergence false-blocker behavior and summary task metadata only. No public docs update is required; plan.md documents the explicit exclusion of the 10 historical high-priority gaps from this story scope.
